# What each platform's agent binaries are built from, the OS they target rather than the CI
# runner. build.yml is run by hand and takes its platform list from here (build-changes.sh
# --list); `git diff --name-only | build-changes.sh` tells which platforms a change touches.
# One "platform: glob" per line. `*` does not cross a `/`, `**` does, `**/` also matches no
# directory. "all" is every platform. consistency.sh check 8 asserts the makefile's source
# trees and every OpenSSL target are listed here.

# Shared by every agent binary
all: makefile
all: build-env.sh
all: fetch-toolchains.sh
all: meshconsole/**
all: meshcore/**
all: microscript/**
all: microstack/**
all: openssl/VERSION
all: openssl/*/include/**

# Per platform: the OpenSSL archives it links, plus what only it consumes
linux: lib-jpeg-turbo/**
linux: openssl/*/linux-*/**
macos: lib-jpeg-turbo/**
macos: openssl/*/macos-*/**
macos: test/**
freebsd: lib-jpeg-turbo/**
freebsd: openssl/*/freebsd-*/**
openbsd: lib-jpeg-turbo/**
openbsd: openssl/*/openbsd-*/**
windows: meshservice/**
windows: *.sln
windows: **/*.vcxproj
windows: **/*.vcxproj.filters
windows: **/*.props
windows: openssl/*/windows-*/**
windows: openssl/build/windows/toolset-check.ps1


# A platform's own workflow file is not an input for now: a comment sweep across all of them
# rebuilt every platform. Test an edited workflow with `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>`.
# linux: .github/workflows/linux-build.yml
# macos: .github/workflows/mac-build.yml
# freebsd: .github/workflows/freebsd-build.yml
# openbsd: .github/workflows/openbsd-build.yml
# windows: .github/workflows/windows-build.yml
